reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Scaling up the response to the HIV epidemic through strengthening national capacities, prevention and treatment services for most at risk population and maintaining access to and quality of essential MDR/XDR TB services in the Republic of Azerbaijan - Azerbaijan (01-Jan-2021-30-Jun-2024)

description.narrative: Azerbaijan, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Azerbaijan (MOH Azerbaijan)This program has the following goals: To reduce HIV incidence and AIDS related mortality in Azerbaijan through scaled access of key affected populations to essential HIV prevention, diagnostic, treatment, care and support services. To reduce the socio-economic burden of TB in Azerbaijan through significant decline in TB (including drug-resistant TB) incidence, prevalence, and mortality. The objectives of this program are: To implement scaled evidence-based preventive activities focused on key affected populations. To achieve 90-90-90 HIV targets. Support health systems strengthening and integrate HIV/TB services to maximize health outcomes for patients. Ensure integrated, patient-centered care for TB with increased treatment success. Ensure program transition to national funding and sustainability
